'''Uriek''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref> located in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] sector of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a young [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], [[Mellora Falon]], went on an expedition to the planet Uriek, where she befriended [[Granta Omega]].<ref name="JQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uriek was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]'', which was written by [[Jude Watson]]<ref name="JQ" /> and released in [[2002]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Uriek system/Legends|Uriek star system]] and the planet itself in grid square T-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
